signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: Usage is metered (credits or quotas) on the vendor's pages.

signals.label: Discount size

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased can buy more codes to increase limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased Reoon Email Verifier can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit is a reviewer wishing for more flexibility with code stacking to scale, which does not directly show whether previous customers can or cannot buy more codes to increase limits.

exhibits.quote: My only wish? A bit more flexibility with code stacking for those of us who want to scale!
exhibits.argument: Reviewer reports stacking to scale is inflexible, undermining the claim that buyers can buy more codes to increase limits.

trials.claim: Buyers get all future updates to the Daily Credits Plan
trials.claimQuote: All future Reoon Email Verifier Daily Credits Plan updates
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about future Daily Credits Plan updates.

trials.claim: Seller claims to be the most accurate email validation service for cleaning invalid, temporary and unsafe addresses
trials.claimQuote: The most accurate email validation service that cleans invalid, temporary & unsafe email addresses
trials.reasoning: The vendor admits not all spamtraps can be detected, and a buyer reports over a 10% bounce rate using only 'Safe' results, materially undercutting the most-accurate cleaning claim despite the vendor repeating it.

exhibits.quote: Please note that, spamtraps are designed to act dynamically and due to their nature all spamtraps cannot be detected.
exhibits.argument: Vendor admits all spamtraps cannot be detected, undermining the claim of most accurate cleaning of unsafe addresses.

exhibits.quote: After using the product to verify email addresses and then only emailing those they claimed with the safest of all the options they provided, "Safe - Include Safe to Send Only," my campaign has seen more than a 10% bounce rate.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports over 10% bounce rate even using only Safe results, contradicting the most-accurate claim.

exhibits.quote: The most accurate online bulk email validation service that cleans invalid, temporary & unsafe email addresses from your email list and protects your email server's reputation.
exhibits.argument: This vendor statement directly matches the claimed most-accurate cleaning promise.

exhibits.quote: The verification is fast, accurate, and helps reduce bounce rates significantly.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms the verification works accurately in practice.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.reasoning: A purchaser reports that after signing up and linking, they received only 20 per day and 100 credits, which conflicts with being grandfathered into the new feature limits.

exhibits.quote: I've just signed up and linked it, and it shows I'm only getting 20 a day and 100 credits.
exhibits.argument: Purchaser reports receiving only free-tier limits after linking, undermining grandfathering into new feature limits.

trials.claim: API supports quick and power verification modes for workflow integration
trials.claimQuote: Reoon Email Verifier offers an API that supports quick and power verification modes, allowing integration into various workflows.
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes the API's quick verification mode, and a buyer confirms both Quick Verifier and Power Verifier exist and work, with no contrary evidence.

exhibits.quote: Verify users’ emails live within 0.5 seconds with our API’s quick verification mode.
exhibits.argument: This vendor statement confirms the API offers a quick verification mode.

exhibits.quote: I really like the verifier. Just a heads-up — the Quick Verifier and Power Verifier use the same credits, but the Power one takes a bit longer and gives fewer bounces.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms both Quick and Power verification modes exist and work.
